description: Create a booking request for a slot returned by get_available_slots. Only call after the user explicitly confirmed the service, date, time and their name and e-mail. The booking is created as "pending" and the slot is held for 30 minutes; the customer must click the confirmation link sent to their e-mail, otherwise it expires. After that the business's own confirmation policy applies (instant or manual approval). Tell the user to check their inbox.

answers.description: Answers to service booking questions, if the service has any.

customerEmail.description: Customer e-mail. The customer must click the confirmation link sent to this address.

date.description: Slot date (YYYY-MM-DD) exactly as returned by get_available_slots.

teamMemberId.description: Team member id from get_available_slots. Omit to let bnod pick a free team member.

time.description: Slot start time (HH:MM, business timezone) exactly as returned by get_available_slots.

name: create_booking
title: Request a booking
